Vi-skogen Expert Desk Agroforestry and carbon credits

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet för insatsen är att bidra till utveckling av ansvarsfulla och inkluderande marknader för utsläppskrediter i Afrika. Expert Desken kommer att bidra till det långsiktiga målet att öka utbudet av landbaserade projekt för utsläppsminskning och som även gynnar människor som lever i fattigdom och deras försörjning.

The overall goal of contribution is to contribute to the development of responsible and inclusive carbon markets in/ with Africa. The Expert Desk will contribute to a long-term goal of increasing the supply of land-based projects that achieve emission reductions and also benefit people living in poverty and their livelihoods.

Det övergripande målet för insatsen är att bidra till utveckling av ansvarsfulla och inkluderande marknader för utsläppskrediter i Afrika. Expertdesken kommer att bidra till det långsiktiga målet att öka utbudet av landbaserade projekt för utsläppsminskning och som även gynnar människor som lever i fattigdom och deras försörjning.
Genom att stödja etableringen av en expertdesk kan Sida bidra till ökad möjlighet att nå nyckelgrupper, organisationer och beslutsfattare och ge stöd i linje med Sidas mandat. Detta innebär att metoder, lärdomar och samlad erfarenhet av bästa praxis för klimatkompensation och hållbar markförvaltning skulle kunna skalas upp för att nå fler människor och ge positiva effekter för Sidas målgrupper.
Stödet bidrar bland annat till följande aktiviteter: - Etablering av Expertdesk och nominering och val av projektledare och experter. - Sätta strukturer för rådgivning, kunskapsdelning, insamling av resultat, rapportering. - Design av kommunikationsplan för att nå användare och målgrupper. - Utveckla kunskap- och kompetensförhöjande läromedel (eg. rapporter, kurser, guider, seminarier). - Anordna seminarier för, och tillsammans med organisationer som efterfrågar stöd.

description.narrative:
Below is a summary of the results that have been achieved during the period under review of the expert desk: -
(i) The carbon desk produced several key resources to support Sida and its partners in navigating carbon markets. Among these were a checklist for assessing carbon project proposals, an A-Z guide for developing an Agriculture Forestry and Land Use (AFOLU) carbon project, and reports on benefit-sharing mechanisms and experiences with carbon crediting standards. Additionally, a series of informational videos have been developed to expand knowledge sharing beyond Sida partners. A comprehensive mapping document has been developed, which highlights the nature of over 80 carbon-related inquiries received over the past two years for support.
(ii) As part of the support to Sida partners based on the requests through embassies, the carbon expert desk engaged in providing expert support to embassies through technical feedback/support in meetings, document reviews upon request by embassies, and technical support for various initiatives embassies are assessing for financial support. Key projects supported by the carbon expert desk include; the Rwanda COMBIO project, where Vi-Skogen assessed feasibility and alignment with national climate frameworks, and the Cleantech programme, where guidance was provided on alternative land use strategies. Other collaborations included advisory support to Northern Rangeland Trust, a technical review of Sidas carbon market strategy, and discussions with organizations such as Biocarbon, GIZ, and Upya Company on standards, methodology, and digital data collection.
(iii) As part of strengthening the knowledge on carbon markets, the expert desk developed various communication outputs including: - Dedicated webpage to introduce Sida, partners, and stakeholders to the Expert Desk, outlining its function, purpose, and contact information as well as the process of getting the required support from the desk. The expert desk has developed communication materials based on past inquiries and Sidas needs including videos, booklets, and briefs. As a result, Vi-Skogen has publicly shared the informational materials produced during the project period, ensuring Sida staff and partners had easy access via the website. Here is the link to the knowledge hub: https://viagroforestry.org/knowledge-library-carbon-expert-desk.
(iv) During the pilot year, Vi-Skogen established a collaboration with the Swedish International Water Institute (SIWI) to exchange knowledge, as they are also developing a help desk. SIWI and Vi-Skogen are working on joint activities and exploring opportunities to scale up the help desks, focusing on water-smart forest and landscape restoration (W-FLR) and carbon offset primarily. This was an unexpected result of the project. This demonstrates the value added advantage of Sida support to broader Sweden's support to other initiatives.
